name: Will generating structured data actually improve my SEO and AI search visibility?

mainEntity.name: Will generating structured data actually improve my SEO and AI search visibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured data generation improves AI search rankings by making your content machine-readable, increasing eligibility for AI Overviews, featured snippets, and rich results. Eligibility depends on using supported schema types with all required properties and passing Google's quality thresholds. Key outcomes include higher click-through rates, more impressions in Search Console, and better placement in AI-generated answers. Focus on types tied to your goals: Organization for brand, Product for sales, Article for content. Measure eligible impressions and CTR by feature, then tune templates as SERP rules change.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it increases eligibility for AI Overviews, featured snippets, and rich results by making content machine-readable, boosting CTR and impressions.
